purpose: targeted hunt for POSITIVES across seven mechanism classes not yet covered, motivated by the measured finding that a positive is worth about 4x a null
result: ZERO verified new enhancers. Every CONFIRMED candidate was an impairment exposure.

lanes_and_verdicts.cholinesterase_inhibitors: ZERO qualifying enhancer positives. No clean healthy-adult meta-analysis with a positive pooled cognitive effect exists for donepezil, galantamine, rivastigmine, physostigmine or huperzine. The absence is the finding.
lanes_and_verdicts.noradrenergic: one qualifying meta-analysis, and it is an impairer (propranolol). The verifier returned REJECT_MISDESCRIBED on proposing it as a positive.
lanes_and_verdicts.histaminergic_orexinergic: ZERO enhancer positives; the one qualifying pooled estimate runs in the impairment direction.
lanes_and_verdicts.hormonal_metabolic: close to barren across DHEA, GH/IGF-1, thyroid, glucocorticoids, EPO, metformin, statins, GLP-1 agonists, NR/NMN.
lanes_and_verdicts.glutamatergic_gabaergic: ZERO enhancers. Every readable pooled estimate points to impairment, which is mechanistically expected for NMDA antagonists, GABA-A PAMs and ethanol.
lanes_and_verdicts.micronutrient_and_diet: mostly barren; the single-micronutrient story is a wall of nulls.
lanes_and_verdicts.peptides_and_misc: no qualifying clean-healthy positive survived verification.

rejected.propranolol: REJECT_MISDESCRIBED: proposing it as a POSITIVE inverts its direction
rejected.soy_isoflavones: UNCERTAIN on both attempts; population never stated in a readable source
rejected.second_generation_antihistamines: CONFIRMED but omitted: same WMD-not-SMD metric problem as the first-generation row, and a second near-null impairer adds nothing measurable
rejected.first_generation_antihistamines: CONFIRMED by verification, but REMOVED after adding: the source reports a weighted mean difference in raw test units, not a standardised effect size, so representative_g had to be left null. ledger_guard then raised missing_effect_size, correctly: a row claiming clean_MA evidence must carry an effect size. Converting WMD to SMD without the source's own pooled SD would have manufactured the number. The guard was obeyed rather than weakened; the row is worth about +0.11% power per row in any case.
